mode: Native PostgreSQL typed standalone SELECT and VALUES set operands with UTF-8 and the pinned native parameter profile.
structure: A resolved binary set tree accepts a checked VALUES relation as a left or right leaf. The native operator and duplicate policy are stored separately.
conditions: Require compatible column kinds, equal widths, the same native profile and the existing checked set tree and signature bounds. A VALUES leaf computes its whole-column result types before set combination, including text for an all-untyped NULL column.
meaning: Apply the selected set or bag operation to the typed row multisets. NULLs compare equal for duplicate and multiplicity processing. Preserve the left input's output column names and positions even if a right operand determines the common kind.
sql: Emit VALUES as a native arm, parenthesize nested set operators and emit the specified operator and ALL policy. Keep the leftmost heading and native resolved literal type declarations.
observations: Independent set-tree shape, operands, operator, duplicate policy and typed leaf positions

Signed int4 to int8 widening and independently resolved all-untyped VALUES text
Readiness of a native typed SELECT parameter with a parameter-free VALUES arm
